THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA
ORAL ORDER

This Court, on 20.09.2024, had passed the following order:
" Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner.
Learned HCGP waives notice for respondent No.1 NC: 2024:KHC:40197 Issue emergent notice to respondent No.2.

The petitioner is accused No.1, husband of the complainant is calling in question the proceedings in C.C.No.36996/2021 registered for offences punishable under Section 498A of the IPC and under Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
The parties were before the Family Court in M.C.No.6068/2022 and have settled the dispute between them by drawing up certain terms of settlement.
Terms of settlement would also recognize the co-operation with the closure of the subject proceedings by the complainant-wife.
